pages.title: Levi's Echo
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Melee Weapons$(br2)§lEffect: §r Attacks stack marks; at 3 stacks, deals magic damage based on the target's max health to targets with at least 50 health.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with other melee damage/growth-type enchantments; only one may be applied to a weapon.
